key_decisions: Used the shared Radix Dialog primitive for the gallery and its nested image preview so focus and dismissal remain consistent.
Made image preview keyboard-accessible through the shared Button and kept its embedded image decorative to avoid duplicate announcements.
Kept signed URLs and noopener/noreferrer on external links; moved copy feedback to the clipboard promise result.
lessons_learned: An interactive offline component audit can bundle the target and its required shared primitives, while stubbing unrelated app service, settings, and route-preload imports; temporary harness files must be removed by the runner.
Wait for shared Radix dialog animations to settle before checking its rendered bounds.
